# because.phybase

### Phylogenetic Bayesian Structural Equation Models (PhyBaSE) extension for ‘because’

`because.phybase` extends the [because](https://because-pkg.github.io)
package with support for phylogenetic covariance structures. It
implements S3 methods for `phylo` and `multiPhylo` objects from the
`ape` package, enabling Bayesian Structural Equation Models with
phylogenetically-structured residuals (PhyBaSE, von Hardenberg &
Gonzalez-Voyer, 2025).

## Features

- **Phylogenetic Covariance**: Incorporates phylogenetic relatedness
  into `because` models.
- **Phylogenetic Uncertainty**: Supports `multiPhylo` objects to account
  for uncertainty in tree topology or branch lengths.
- **Measurement error**: Accounting for measurement error in traits both
  providing repeated measures as well as specifying known measurement
  error variances.
- **Phylogenetic missing data imputation**: informs imputation of
  missing data using phylogenetic relationships.
- **Seamless Integration**: Designed to work transparently with
  `because` via S3 method dispatch.

## Installation

To install the **stable release** (`v1.1.0`), run:

``` r

remotes::install_github("because-pkg/because.phybase@v1.1.0")
```

To install the **latest development version**, run:

``` r

remotes::install_github("because-pkg/because.phybase")
```

`because.phybase` depends on `because` which will be installed
automatically as a dependency. For information on the functions
available in the main `because` package and for tutorials on how to
fully use all its functionalities please refer to the `because`
[documentation](https://because-pkg.github.io).

## Citation

To cite `because.phybase` in publications:

- **Journal article**: \> von Hardenberg, A., & Gonzalez-Voyer, A.
  (2025). PhyBaSE: A Bayesian structural equation model approach to
  causal inference in phylogenetic comparative analyses. *Methods in
  Ecology and Evolution*, 16(6), 1136–1148.
  <https://doi.org/10.1111/2041-210X.70044>

- **R package**: \> von Hardenberg, A., & Gonzalez-Voyer, A. (2026).
  *because.phybase: Phylogenetic Structural Equation Models (PhyBaSE) in
  R*. R package version 1.1.0,
  <https://because-pkg.github.io/because.phybase/>.

# Package index

## Phylogenetic Comparative Tools & Diagnostics

Functions for evolutionary models, multi-tree ensembles, and sensitivity
diagnostics.

- [`evo_model()`](https://because-pkg.github.io/because.phybase/reference/evo_model.md)
  : Attach Evolutionary Model Specifications to Phylogenetic Structures

- [`tree_control()`](https://because-pkg.github.io/because.phybase/reference/tree_control.md)
  :

  Configure Multi-Tree (`multiPhylo`) Sampling and Ensemble Options

- [`check_multiphylo()`](https://because-pkg.github.io/because.phybase/reference/check_multiphylo.md)
  : Check Multi-Tree Convergence and Phylogenetic Sensitivity
  Diagnostics

## S3 Methods for Phylogenetic Structures

Methods extending the because engine for `phylo` and `multiPhylo`
objects.

- [`jags_structure_definition(`*`<phylo>`*`)`](https://because-pkg.github.io/because.phybase/reference/jags_structure_definition.phylo.md)
  : JAGS Structure Definition for Phylogenetic Trees
- [`jags_structure_definition(`*`<multiPhylo>`*`)`](https://because-pkg.github.io/because.phybase/reference/jags_structure_definition.multiPhylo.md)
  : JAGS Structure Definition for Multiple Trees (Phylogenetic
  Uncertainty)
- [`prepare_structure_data(`*`<phylo>`*`)`](https://because-pkg.github.io/because.phybase/reference/prepare_structure_data.phylo.md)
  : Prepare Structure Data for Phylogenetic Trees
- [`prepare_structure_data(`*`<multiPhylo>`*`)`](https://because-pkg.github.io/because.phybase/reference/prepare_structure_data.multiPhylo.md)
  : Prepare Structure Data for Multiple Trees

## Data

- [`rhino.dat`](https://because-pkg.github.io/because.phybase/reference/rhino.dat.md)
  : Rhinograd life-history data
- [`rhino.tree`](https://because-pkg.github.io/because.phybase/reference/rhino.tree.md)
  : Rhinograd phylogenetic tree
- [`RhinoMulti.dat`](https://because-pkg.github.io/because.phybase/reference/RhinoMulti.dat.md)
  : Rhinograd Simulated Repeated Measures Data
- [`RhinoMulti_se.dat`](https://because-pkg.github.io/because.phybase/reference/RhinoMulti_se.dat.md)
  : Rhinograd Means and Standard Errors
